role: Business Intelligence Engineer, Prime Video International - Finance Analytics
responsibilities: Work with business, finance, and other BIEs and leadership to identify data needs and requirements
Generate and present concrete and actionable insights and recommendations for leadership based on sound methodological analysis
Communicate analysis results and techniques, both verbally and in writing, clearly and confidently to peers and business partners
Build mechanisms to surface knowledge and learnings about to the business
Recognize and adopt best practices in reporting/analysis; write quality code to retrieve and analyze data
Set up and maintain self-service infrastructure (e.g. dashboards) for the team using data visualization solutions (e.g. QuickSuite)
Lead large scale data and analytical projects that help scale the business across Prime Video International and Worldwide

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Prime Video is a fast-paced, growth business
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Speed language ("fast-paced, growth business", "dynamic environment") roughly balances the reliability language ("single-source-of-truth metrics layer", "reliable ETL/ELT workflows").
evidence.domain_risk: we own the single-source-of-truth metrics layer that serves both finance and business leadership
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Finance analytics for content and business decisions, without financial-reporting or compliance framing, is moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: The team is embedded within finance alongside content and business finance partners
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A dedicated finance analytics team owning a metrics layer inside Prime Video is mature.
evidence.jd_authorship: Work with business, finance, and other BIEs and leadership to identify data needs and requirements
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The bullets are generic ("Communicate analysis results and techniques") and could apply to most BI roles.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: the single-source-of-truth metrics layer that serves both finance and business leadership
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The primary audience is the finance function and leadership.
evidence.autonomy_level: Lead large scale data and analytical projects
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Leading projects sits beside routine delivery and support for business partners.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The JD expects no AI skill from the candidate.
evidence.testing_framing: No testing or data quality signal.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Beyond "write quality code", no testing, data quality or monitoring practice is named.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is framed in insight and delivery terms.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Set up and maintain self-service infrastructure (e.g. dashboards) for the team
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Setting up and maintaining self-service infrastructure is a mixed mission.
